subject: How to insert a function from rLiDAR into Shiny?

messages.author: 8f6e55336a3a1913
messages.subject: How to insert a function from rLiDAR into Shiny?
parts:
Hello guys,

I'm trying to generate the summary of a table on Shiny that comes from a rLiDAR function "FindTreesCHM". However, I'm having trouble to figure out how to insert this function in server.R. Here's what I was trying to do:

output$summary <- renderTable({

table <- summary(Arv.List)


Arv.List<-FindTreesCHM(chm, sws, hmin)

})

The function is FindTreesCHM(chm, sws, hmin)

Does anyone have any ideas of how to make it works?
